requirement: V27 R48: an optional worker failure leaves the host running and retains uncertain effect receipts; installed acceptance requires an exercised fault and recovery contour.

findings.fact: The scenario observes existing failure status only. It has no public fault trigger; the observed branch also records that this harness did not inject the failure.
The coordinator uses a private fixed set of eleven in-process worker types; the inspected public contract does not admit a new owned test worker.
The worker status summary contains state, failure count and error code; it contains no worker process identity.
Module supervision has a separate owned-child PID/birth/image contract; it cannot be substituted for the legacy optional-worker contour.
Module health recording requires supervisor scope; manufacturing a health record would not demonstrate an actual worker fault.

required_evidence: A supported admitted worker activation and actual fault path for the worker type under test
Exact ownership and lifecycle evidence appropriate to that worker implementation
Public host survival and retained uncertain effect receipts after the actual fault
Public recovery evidence rather than observation of a pre-existing failure
interpretation: This source audit explains why the corrected M core receipt remains not qualified. It does not upgrade existing failure observations to fault-injection or recovery acceptance.
